heard: This colossal galaxy spans 16 million light years across. It is huge! A hundred Milky Way's laid end-to-end barely match it. Astronomers found the Titan hidden in the northern constellation of Lynx. Twin jet streams power its lobes from a central supermassive black hole. Yet, despite its record-breaking plumes, the central galaxy is completely ordinary. That is why 16 million light years of space can hide such an ordinary heart.
